ai-coding-delegate v1.0.2

- No code or documentation changes detected in this release.
- Version bump only; behavior and instructions remain unchanged.

Initial release of the coding-agent skill, a bash-first agent delegator for advanced coding tasks.

- Enables background delegation of coding work to Codex, Claude Code, Pi, or OpenCode agents.
- Supports complex coding workflows: building features, PR review, large-scale refactoring, and iterative exploration.
- Enforces correct PTY and permission-mode settings per agent for compatibility and safety.
- Provides detailed usage patterns for workdirs, session monitoring, and background execution.
- Offers guidelines and safety notes for PR reviews and parallel issue work via git worktrees.
- Not for simple fixes, code reading, or thread-bound requests—use cases are clearly scoped.
